documented_probe: C-4b78df73 (run a multi-process distributed training function under the gloo backend): the program must spawn N rank-aware worker processes joined by a gloo CPU process group, move shards into float32 CPU tensors, all-reduce sufficient statistics, and emit per-rank markers plus an aggregated fit. The verifier re-runs the deliverable with hidden worker counts (including more workers than rows, so idle ranks must still join and write markers) and hidden datasets, checking backend identity, exact round-robin shard sizes, and agreement with an independent serial least-squares reference.
notes: Hard: process-group initialization, spawn guard, rendezvous hygiene, rank-aware sharding (round-robin, including zero-row ranks), explicit device/dtype movement, and collective reduction must all work simultaneously or the run hangs or produces wrong artifacts. Verifier executes the deliverable on three hidden datasets with 3/5/7 workers and checks fit.json against a serial reference plus per-rank marker fidelity.
